qcTitle: Know what your QC photos can tell you.
qcIntro: A product listing photo and a photo of your own warehouse item serve different purposes. Learn what to check, when to ask for more detail and where a photograph has limits.
qcNoticeTitle: Listing photos are not verified QC
qcNotice: This catalogue displays available source images. It does not currently provide a verified, order-specific QC lookup. Review your own order photos in your Superbuy account.
qcCheck1Text: Compare the label, colour and visible details with the order you actually placed.
qcCheck2Text: Check visible seams, prints and surfaces. A photo cannot establish authenticity or internal performance.
qcCheck3Text: If a detail matters, request the specific view or measurement through the service available on your order.
shippingTitle: Make room for shipping in your budget.
shippingIntro: International shipping depends on the parcel, destination and available route. Use current Superbuy tools and compare realistic parcel scenarios before making a decision.
shippingNote: This site does not calculate or guarantee shipping prices, customs charges or delivery dates.
